items.quote: I recently hired JLR Fencing to install about 200 feet of fencing, two wooden single-door gates, and two double-door aluminum gates, and I couldn't be happier with the results.

I highly recommend JLR Fencing. Jose and his team are amazing. I needed a couple of fences installed asap. He responded to my message right away and came to give a quote. Two days later his installer was at my house doing an impeccable job.
Really happy with the work JLR Fencing did at my house. They handled the pavers, turf, and fence, and everything came out great.
